description: miniOrange SAML 2.0 SSO library enables secure authentication in ASP.NET Core and .NET Framework (MVC, WebForms, Web API) applications using Identity Providers like Azure AD, ADFS, Okta, PingFederate, Salesforce, Auth0, Google Workspace, and other SAML 2.0-compliant IdPs.
summary: Enable secure SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On (SSO) for ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET Framework applications using Azure AD, Okta, ADFS, and other SAML 2.0 IdPs.
title: miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On for ASP.NET
